pymrm_H_vs_eq38_rel.note: discretisation error at n_z = 1400, dt = 1 s; grid-limited

pymrm_grid_order.note: observed order of the two-station H from successive differences on n_z = 350, 700, 1400, 2800 (dt = 0.5 s), the one farther from 3; van Leer is formally second order and H converges faster, so only the range is claimed

pymrm_grid_roundoff_margin.note: smallest successive difference of the grid ladder over n_steps eps H

pymrm_upwind_dispersion_coeff.note: mean (H - H_38)/h with bare upwind; the prediction is exactly 1

pymrm_upwind_dispersion_coeff_err.note: |mean (H - H_38)/h - 1| with bare upwind over n_z = 350, 700, 1400 (dt = 0.5 s): the leading-order coefficient is exactly 1, so this is the O(h) remainder plus the time error; the bound admits that remainder and fails any scheme whose numerical dispersion is not u h / 2

pymrm_dt_order_upwind_dev.note: worst |order - 2| of c_I(z2) at t = 4800 and 5200 s over dt = 8 to 0.5 s, linear Crank-Nicolson (limiter off), successive differences

pymrm_dt_roundoff_margin.note: smallest finest successive difference of c_I(z2) over n_steps eps c_I

pymrm_dt_swing_H.note: relative spread of the two-station H, van Leer, over dt = 8 to 0.5 s; the bound keeps it 40x below the baseline's own error against eq (38)

pymrm_deferred_vs_newton_H_rel.note: two-station H of the one-sweep deferred correction against the same theta scheme solved by newton with the ConvFluxTVD Jacobian, n_z = 350, dt = 2 s; the bound keeps it below the reported run's own error against eq (38)

pymrm_dt_mu1_sign_changes.note: sign changes in the successive differences of mu1(z2) on the van Leer dt ladder (n_z = 700): the limited march has no regular time order there

pymrm_mu1_deferred_vs_newton_rel.note: mu1(z2) of the one-sweep deferred correction against the same theta scheme solved by newton, n_z = 350, dt = 2 s; the lag moves the absolute moment

pymrm_mu1z1_deferred_vs_newton_rel.note: mu1(z1) of the one-sweep deferred correction against the same theta scheme solved by newton, n_z = 350, dt = 2 s; printed beside the mu1(z2) and H gaps

pymrm_kappa3_vs_laplace_rel.note: cancellation-limited at n_z = 1400, dt = 1 s; a regression guard

pymrm_kappa4_vs_laplace_rel.note: cancellation-limited at n_z = 1400, dt = 1 s; a regression guard

pymrm_bc_insensitivity.note: relative move of the two-station H when the Danckwerts inlet is replaced by a Dirichlet one; a difference of nearly equal plate heights. The bound keeps it 4x below the baseline's own error against eq (38)

eq56_coefficient.note: D_II / (100 D_I) from the printed constants

table1_calc_frac_reproduced.note: fraction of Table 1's eleven printed calc values reproduced

eq21_corrected_large_a_dev.note: the corrected eq (21) at a = 5 against the a + sqrt(2 pi) of eq (25); an asymptotic error, not round-off

eq21_printed_solvable_rows.note: Table 2 rows (A = 5 ml) for which the width route with eq (21) as printed has a root on [A/25, 1e4] ml (find_roots, 400-point log scan)

group2_at_recovered_column.note: F_I u/(alpha z) at the recovered length

sym_chain_residual.note: sympy simplifies (38) with (45), (46), (48) substituted, minus (49), to 0; recorded as 1 if it does not

sym_chain_exact_count.note: steps of the symbolic chain whose residual sympy simplifies to 0, of 4

rootfind_vs_closed_form_optimum.note: max relative gap between u_opt root-found on dH/du = -B/u^2 + C = 0 (find_roots, 1e-3 to 1e3 mm/s, xtol 1e-15) and the closed form sqrt(B/C): an identity that tests the root finder on that expression only
